# 验证说明

本文使用**模拟数据**验证 QMD 编辑、同一 R 会话的连续计算、原生结果与独立渲染。 数据来自旁边的 `measurements.csv`；App 不建立项目、不收集资源，也不提供数据网格。

> 检查重点：中文、前导零、真正缺失值、包含逗号及换行的字符字段，以及多图和多种输出。

| 内容         | 规模 | 预期                 |
|:-------------|-----:|:---------------------|
| 模拟原始记录 |  240 | 3 个中心             |
| 完整配对     |  233 | 排除 7 个缺失配对    |
| Bootstrap    |  600 | 固定随机种子         |
| R 代码块     |   12 | 最后输出验证通过标记 |

## 环境与执行次数

```{r}
#| label: validation-setup
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.5
.validation_run_count <- if (exists('.validation_run_count', inherits = FALSE)) .validation_run_count + 1L else 1L
.bootstrap_runs <- 0L
set.seed(20261106)
stopifnot(requireNamespace('knitr', quietly = TRUE), requireNamespace('ggplot2', quietly = TRUE))
message('VALIDATION_MESSAGE: expected message; not a failure')
warning('VALIDATION_WARNING: deliberately generated to check warning display', call. = FALSE)
cat('Run count:', .validation_run_count, '\nR:', as.character(getRversion()), '\n')
```

# 导入、清洗与缺失审计

## 外部 CSV 与类型保护

```{r}
#| label: validation-import
raw <- read.csv('measurements.csv', colClasses = c('character', 'character', 'numeric', 'numeric', 'character'),
                na.strings = 'NA', check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = 'UTF-8')
stopifnot(nrow(raw) == 240L, raw$sample_id[1L] == '00001', grepl('中文', raw$note[1L]), grepl('\n', raw$note[2L]))
raw$site <- factor(raw$site, levels = c('Site A', 'Site B', 'Site C'))
keep <- is.finite(raw$reference) & is.finite(raw$candidate)
paired <- raw[keep, , drop = FALSE]
paired$average <- (paired$reference + paired$candidate) / 2
paired$difference <- paired$candidate - paired$reference
cat('Imported:', nrow(raw), 'Complete pairs:', nrow(paired), 'Excluded:', sum(!keep), '\n')
head(raw, 4)
```

## 按中心审计

```{r}
#| label: validation-audit
audit <- do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(raw$site), function(s) {
  k <- raw$site == s
  data.frame(Site = s, Total = sum(k), Complete = sum(keep[k]), Excluded = sum(!keep[k]))
}))
knitr::kable(audit, caption = '按中心的完整配对与排除记录', row.names = FALSE)
```

## 描述统计与 t 区间

```{r}
#| label: validation-descriptive
summary_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(paired$site), function(s) {
  x <- paired$difference[paired$site == s]
  se <- sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)); half <- qt(0.975, df = length(x) - 1) * se
  data.frame(Site = s, N = length(x), Mean = mean(x), SD = sd(x), Lower = mean(x) - half, Upper = mean(x) + half)
}))
knitr::kable(summary_table, digits = 4, caption = '差值 Candidate − Reference 的分中心描述统计', row.names = FALSE)
```

# 模型与关系图

回归模型为 $Y_i = \beta_0 + \beta_1 X_i + \epsilon_i$。

```{r}
#| label: validation-regression
fit <- lm(candidate ~ reference, data = paired)
print(summary(fit))
coefficient_table <- cbind(Estimate = coef(fit), confint(fit))
knitr::kable(coefficient_table, digits = 5, caption = '回归系数与95%置信区间')
```

```{r}
#| label: validation-scatter
#| fig-cap: "不同中心的配对测量及回归线"
scatter_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(paired, ggplot2::aes(reference, candidate, colour = site)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.7, alpha = 0.75) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = 2, colour = 'grey55') +
  ggplot2::geom_smooth(ggplot2::aes(group = 1), method = 'lm', formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, colour = '#225EA8') +
  ggplot2::labs(title = 'Paired measurements', x = 'Reference', y = 'Candidate', colour = 'Site') +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
scatter_plot
```

# 差值与重采样

差值定义为 $d_i = Y_i-X_i$，展示界限为 $\bar d \pm 1.96s_d$。 这里直接使用基础 R 计算，为软件验证示例，不调用 GUI 分析模块。

```{r}
#| label: validation-agreement
bias <- mean(paired$difference)
loa <- bias + c(-1, 1) * qnorm(0.975) * sd(paired$difference)
agreement <- data.frame(Measure = c('Mean difference', 'Lower LoA', 'Upper LoA'), Value = c(bias, loa))
knitr::kable(agreement, digits = 5, caption = '平均差与展示界限', row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: validation-agreement-plot
#| fig-cap: "平均值与差值关系：复用上块计算的界限"
agreement_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(paired, ggplot2::aes(average, difference, colour = site)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = bias, colour = '#225EA8', linewidth = 0.6) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = loa, colour = '#CB181D', linetype = 2) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = 'Difference versus mean', x = '(Reference + Candidate) / 2', y = 'Candidate - Reference', colour = 'Site') +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
agreement_plot
```

```{r}
#| label: validation-bootstrap
.bootstrap_runs <- .bootstrap_runs + 1L
set.seed(20261106)
boot_mean <- replicate(600, mean(sample(paired$difference, replace = TRUE)))
bootstrap_ci <- unname(quantile(boot_mean, c(0.025, 0.975), type = 7))
knitr::kable(data.frame(Replicates = length(boot_mean), Bias = bias, Lower = bootstrap_ci[1], Upper = bootstrap_ci[2]),
             digits = 5, caption = '固定种子的百分位 Bootstrap 区间', row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: validation-bootstrap-plot
#| fig-cap: "600次重采样均值的分布"
bootstrap_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(data.frame(value = boot_mean), ggplot2::aes(value)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 28, fill = '#74A9CF', colour = 'white') +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = bootstrap_ci, colour = '#CB181D', linetype = 2) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = bias, colour = '#225EA8') +
  ggplot2::labs(title = 'Bootstrap mean difference', x = 'Resampled mean difference', y = 'Frequency') +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
bootstrap_plot
```

# 多图诊断与最终校验

```{r}
#| label: validation-diagnostics
#| fig-cap: "同一模型的四联诊断图，不重新拟合"
local({
  old <- par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(2.6, 2.6, 1.8, 0.5), mgp = c(1.5, 0.4, 0), cex = 0.65)
  on.exit(par(old))
  plot(fit, which = 1:4, ask = FALSE, id.n = 0)
})
```

## 自动检查清单

1.  CSV 中的前导零、中文、逗号、引号和字符内换行保留。
2.  所有分析块共用同一 R 会话；回归只拟合一次，诊断图复用模型。
3.  切换 Code / Visual、查看结果和保存文档不重新运行 Bootstrap。
4.  独立 Quarto 渲染从外部 CSV 重新计算，不读取交互会话。

```{r}
#| label: validation-checks
stopifnot(nrow(paired) == 233L, sum(!keep) == 7L, sum(summary_table$N) == 233L,
          .validation_run_count >= 1L, .bootstrap_runs == 1L,
          length(boot_mean) == 600L, all(is.finite(boot_mean)), bootstrap_ci[1] < bias, bootstrap_ci[2] > bias,
          coef(fit)[['reference']] > 0.99, coef(fit)[['reference']] < 1.06,
          isTRUE(all.equal(bias, unname(mean(paired$candidate - paired$reference)))))
cat(sprintf('COMPLEX_VALIDATION_OK rows=240 complete=233 excluded=7 bootstrap=600 run_count=%d bootstrap_runs=%d\n', .validation_run_count, .bootstrap_runs))
versions <- data.frame(Component = c('R', 'ggplot2', 'knitr'),
                       Version = c(as.character(getRversion()), as.character(utils::packageVersion('ggplot2')), as.character(utils::packageVersion('knitr'))))
knitr::kable(versions, caption = '本次实际运行版本', row.names = FALSE)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

**完成标记：**最后一个代码块应显示 `COMPLEX_VALIDATION_OK`。预期 message/warning 不属于失败；任何真正错误都应停止后续块。
